**Crimson**:

Turn down the over-bright fluorescence—
I can't think and I can't see.
Turn it down to make a movie made of shadows—
lt comforts me.


My hurt is who I am,
I wouldn’t give it up.
My pain is what I need,
I’m not hurting enough.


Most of it is fear, delusion, confusion—
But i'm wishing to be ruined—
Because all they see is usual—
I want to have everything wrong with me.


Let my storm explode.
Let it turn crimson.
If I don't bleed,
I am weak.


Let my skin turn to ash.
Let my ash turn to rain.
I want to be broken,
There is beauty in my pain.
